correctness.rationale: Both source-defined operators output only facets satisfying the factual input. Definition 5.1 explicitly fixes any already-satisfying facet. For Definition 5.2, if all current facets satisfy the input, the internal-selection branch is nonempty, stays inside the current belief-facet set, and contains each input facet. Hence the fixed points are exactly the input-supported models. Idempotence and semantic entailment absorption follow immediately.

value.rationale: The primary paper identifies iterated oscillation as a conceptual problem and introduces memory variants in response. The theorem proves a sharp structural limit on that pathology: every factual basic revision is already a one-step retraction, with a precise fixed-point class and an entailment-absorption law. This is directly useful for analyzing iteration and action-model compositions.
